answer: What breaks first is the key, not the account. Each task carries a session key, and a replayed submission is clawed back before the payout clears, so the operator keeps the name and loses the work. A farm spread over one oasis of 80 agents then has to re-earn a key for every task it wants paid, and the raven log writes each revocation next to the yarrow count of failed bids. Trust lands on the task; an address is only where the mail goes.
